# Code of Conduct

RZMPS aims to be a friendly, technical, and constructive project for people
building particle systems, VFX tools, demos, and renderer integrations.

## Expected Behavior

- Be respectful and patient.
- Assume good intent, especially in design and performance discussions.
- Give actionable feedback.
- Credit others for ideas, code, presets, examples, and references.
- Keep criticism focused on the work, not the person.

## Unacceptable Behavior

- Harassment, insults, threats, or personal attacks.
- Discriminatory language or behavior.
- Repeatedly derailing technical discussions.
- Publishing private information without consent.
- Bad-faith issues, pull requests, or reviews.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may edit, hide, or delete comments; close issues; decline pull
requests; or restrict participation when behavior harms the project community.

If you need to report a conduct concern, contact a maintainer privately when a
private channel is available, or open a minimal public issue asking for a
maintainer contact path without naming people or sharing sensitive details.
